description: Facts the release sets by a documented rule, never stored in places/. A rule sets its fact only on a place of its kind that has no value for that fact from any source (OSM, feedback, contributed, owner or community_report). The released record then has the source rule in fact_sources and the rule's name in fact_rules. Apps should present a rule fact as what is usual for that kind of place, for example "Usually no dogs (national park)".
